answer: Ephemeral Interaction Trail. Each new identity must perform real work whose record is seeded by a fresh random beacon (a gale of entropy) and logged in a shared ledger. A duplicate agent replaying prior activity produces a detectable echo, since honest histories diverge at the seed. Every registration also requires paying for a unique jetty slot in the entry queue, a small but nonrefundable fee plus compute. Cloning N personas costs N slot fees and risks pattern-matching across correlated trails, so mass duplication becomes self-revealing before it scales.
